measures.title: County Question - Parks
measures.exactEnglishText:
PARKS, SPORTS, RECREATIONAL
FACILITIES AND BOTANICAL GARDENS TO
BE FINANCED BY GENERAL OBLIGATION
BONDS
Shall the County issue general obligation bonds
in an amount not to exceed $280,000,000,
bearing interest at rates not exceeding the legal
limit and maturing not exceeding 20 years from
the date(s) of issuance payable from ad
valorem taxes levied on all taxable property
within the County to modernize aging parks and
recreation facilities and botanical gardens,
expand and update sports complexes, increase
public beach access and trail connectivity and
develop new regional parks?

measures.title: County Question - Library District
measures.exactEnglishText:
LIBRARY DISTRICT EXPANSION AND
MODERNIZATION PROGRAM TO BE
FINANCED BY GENERAL OBLIGATION
BONDS
Shall Palm Beach County issue bonds in the
aggregate amount not exceeding
$175,000,000, bearing interest at rates not
exceeding the legal limit and maturing not
exceeding 20 years from the date(s) of
issuance, payable from ad valorem taxes levied
for such purposes within the Palm Beach
County Library District for the purpose of
providing funds to pay for the cost of
acquisition, construction, reconstruction,
expansion, improving and equipping Palm
Beach County library facilities?

measures.title: County Question - School District
measures.exactEnglishText:
REFERENDUM TO CONTINUE AD VALOREM
LEVY FOR SCHOOL SAFETY, TEACHERS
AND OPERATIONAL NEEDS
Shall the School District of Palm Beach County
have continued authority to levy 1.00 mills of ad
valorem millage for operational needs of public
schools dedicated to funding school safety;
school police; mental health services; arts,
music, physical education, career and choice
program teachers; and improved teacher pay
beginning July 1, 2027 and automatically
ending June 30, 2031, with oversight of all
funds by an independent committee of citizens
and experts?
